verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a mostly first-party developer ecosystem: an official Python library on GitHub, official SDKs and Agents SDK, and an official Cookbook covering integrations. The API can also reach third-party services through remote MCP servers, and one community user mentions building their own harness around GPT. None of this shows an independent, actively maintained community ecosystem. missing for 10: evidence of community-curated lists, third-party tools or routers, independent integrations with active maintainers, and corroboration of ecosystem vitality beyond first-party materials.
